prompt: Implement the Deutsch-Jozsa circuit for the balanced oracle f(x) = x0 XOR x2 (bit 0 XOR bit 2 of the 3-bit input x; bit 1 is unused). Use qubits 0, 1, 2 as the input register and qubit 3 as the ancilla. Steps: initialize the ancilla (qubit 3) to |1> with an X gate, apply Hadamard to all 4 qubits, apply the oracle as CNOT(control=qubit 0, target=qubit 3) and CNOT(control=qubit 2, target=qubit 3), then apply Hadamard to qubits 0, 1, 2 only (not the ancilla). Return the resulting 4-qubit state; no measurement.
